items.title: Tandem – Real-time collaborative editor with AI attribution tracking
items.raw_excerpt:
I built Tandem to solve a problem I kept running into with Claude Code: *How do you collaborate on documents with AI while maintaining proper attribution?* Current tools (Google Docs, Notion, etc.) were designed for human-to-human collaboration. When I copy-paste Claude's suggestions into a doc, all attribution is lost. My team can't tell which parts I wrote vs AI-generated. In open source, this creates trust issues. *Tandem's approach:*
- Every edit is tagged as Human or AI
- Git-based version control (full history, not just "last modified")
- Real-time collaboration using Yjs CRDT
- MCP integration (AI can directly edit documents using tools) *Tech stack:* React 19, TipTap, Yjs, Hono, Bun, MCP *Live demo:* https://tandem.irisgo.xyz Think "Google Docs meets Git" but designed for human-AI

excerpt_i18n.en: There are moments when one can feel time folding: when the footsteps of predecessors meet the hurried pace of successors, and the two draw close and resonate within the same room. On August 7, 2020, during the "Commemorating Thomas S. Huang—40 Years of Legacy in Chinese Computer Vision" session at the Fifth GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Summit, Harry Shum, Shiqiang Yang, Changwen Chen, Zhengyou Zhang, Qi Tian, and Shuicheng Yan recounted the "40-year legacy" as follows: In 2006, Thomas S. Huang attended a Christmas event organized by Long Quan in Hong Kong and coincidentally discovered that several leading figures in computer vision present at the gathering were each exactly ten years apart in age—Thomas S. Huang (born 1936), Songde Ma (born 1946), Wen Gao (born 1956), and Harry Shum (born 1966). Subsequently, they discussed whether they could find another leading figure in computer vision ten years younger at their next gathering. The discussion quickly pointed to the same person: Harry Shum's protégé, Jian Sun, born in 1976. The protagonists of this story—Songde Ma, Wen Gao, Harry Shum, and Jian Sun—have also been regular attendees of GAIR over the years, gathering there due to legacy and mentorship. Each time they see young people in the GAIR audience with tears in their eyes or young scholars writing in live-stream comments, "This is what I aspire to become," they are filled with anticipation, waiting for these young people, both in the audience and behind screens, to take up the torch of this legacy. December 12, 2025, at Bolin Tianrui, Nanshan, Shenzhen.

El 7 de agosto de 2020, en la quinta edición de la Conferencia Global de Inteligencia Artificial y Robótica (GAIR), durante la sesión "En memoria de Thomas S. Huang: 40 años de legado en visión por computadora en China", figuras como Harry Shum, Yang Shiqiang, Chen Changwen, Zhang Zhengyou, Tian Qi y Yan Shuicheng narraron así el "legado de 40 años": en 2006, Thomas S. Huang viajó a Hong Kong para asistir a un evento navideño organizado por Quan Long, donde descubrió casualmente que varios de los líderes en visión por computadora presentes en la reunión tenían exactamente 10 años de diferencia entre sí, habiendo nacido en 1936.

excerpt_i18n.en:
2025 marks a pivotal year for large models as they transition from "breaking technological barriers" to "deepening value creation." This period witnesses intricate transformations and accelerated integration between technology and industry, resonating in unison. Disruptions of the future are brewing and surging in the dawn of the AI revolution, gradually unveiling a new world to humanity. In this twilight of the era, how to cut through the fog, glimpse opportunities, courageously engage, and embrace this vast, diverse, and complex wave of intelligence is becoming a pressing question for every industry pioneer.  

Since its inception in 2016, the Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Conference (GAIR) has, over the past nine years, repeatedly positioned itself at the forefront of AI transformation. With forward-looking vision, it has accurately and profoundly captured the pulse of AI technology, establishing a core bridge for cutting-edge exchanges among academia, industry, research, and investment.  

As a bellwether in the field of artificial intelligence, previous GAIR conferences have invited multiple Turing Award and Nobel Prize laureates, 50 academicians, 30 chairs of top international AI conferences, over 100 fellows, and more than 500 renowned entrepreneurs, investors, and innovators to gather and discuss AI.  

This year is no exception. On December 12-13, at the banquet hall on the third floor of the Sheraton Shenzhen Bo'Lin Tian Rui Hotel, the 8th GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Conference will bring together hundreds of guests and thousands of experts. It will feature four thematic forums and two closed-door meetings, focusing on topics such as large models, AI computing power, world models, data & one-brain-multiple-forms, and AI hardware, to collectively explore the future of AI.
excerpt_i18n.es: 2025 será un año clave en el que los grandes modelos pasen de "romper barreras tecnológicas" a "profundizar en el valor". Durante este período, la tecnología y la industria experimentarán cambios complejos, resonando y fusionándose a un ritmo acelerado. Esas disrupciones futuras se están gestando y agitando en el amanecer de la revolución de la IA, abriendo lentamente un nuevo mundo ante las personas. En este alba de la era, cómo despejar la niebla, vislumbrar oportunidades, adentrarse con valentía y abrazar esta vasta, diversa y compleja ola de inteligencia se está convirtiendo en la pregunta de cada pionero de la industria. La "Conferencia Global de Inteligencia Artificial y Robótica" (GAIR), iniciada en 2016, se ha situado en numerosas ocasiones a la vanguardia de la transformación de la IA durante los últimos nueve años, con una visión prospectiva.

items.title: 对话英诺王建明：机器人目前面临的核心问题是数据 | GAIR 2025
items.raw_excerpt: 每晚 10 点，城市渐入静谧，英诺天使基金 ED 王建明的 “专属写作时间” 才刚刚开启；周末的时光，也早已被她固定分配给了采访与写作。 这份坚持，源于一直在坚持做的 “石麻笔记”，最初她只是想随手记录工作中接触的技术信息，未曾想，石麻笔记受到了越来越多业内人士的关注，也在潜移默化中改变着她对机器人行业的认知。 早在具身智能成为资本热词之前，英诺王建明就已经踏入机器人赛道。据科技产业投资平台华芯资本统计，在一级市场，2025 年前七个月，具身智能行业总融资金额超过 300 亿元，在 2024 年上半年，这个数字还只是 75 亿元。资本狂欢的背后，却难掩数据困境。 从 2017 年到现在的 2025 年，她几乎见证了这个行业从默默无闻到名扬世界，也比任何人都清楚，若数据难题不解决，再高的融资额也难以支撑行业走得长远。 英诺王建明坦言：“机器人的数据问题如果不被解决的话，具身行业用现在的范式不一定做得通。” 以下是 AI 科技评论与王建明的对话，AI 科技评论对其进行了不改原意的编辑： 01 只是想要记录而已 AI科技评论：最开始做石麻笔记有遇到困难吗？怎么解决的？ 王建明： 没遇到什么困难，因为非常随性，叫“笔记”其实就是因为这只是工作或学习过程的记录，没有什么期待，所以没有什么困难。 AI科技评论：有给自己规定访谈or写作计划吗? 王建明： 没有，完全是随性随机的，我自己有空并且是感兴趣的话题就会想一下，写一下。 AI科技评论：石麻笔记的文章既有专业深度又能让技术小白看懂，您是怎么把握这个平衡的？ 王建明： 我会从我看论文所产生的问题去发问，因为我自己也不是学术背景，也不会问非常专业的问题，而是从比较容易理解这个工作的点来问的，所以问题比较通俗，受访者的回答也会比较照顾我，会简单的解释一些专业问题，因此写出来的内容对于非技术背景也比较容易消化。 AI科技评论：为什么从投资人

excerpt_i18n.en: At 10 p.m. each night, as the city gradually quiets down, Wang Jianming, ED of Inno Angel Fund, begins her dedicated writing time; weekends have long been reserved for interviews and writing. This persistence stems from her ongoing "Shima Notes." Initially, she merely intended to casually record technical information encountered at work, never expecting that Shima Notes would gain increasing attention from industry insiders and subtly reshape her understanding of the robotics sector. Long before embodied intelligence became a buzzword in capital circles, Inno's Wang Jianming had already entered the robotics track. According to statistics from the technology industry investment platform Huaxin Capital, in the primary market, the total financing amount for the embodied intelligence industry exceeded 30 billion yuan in the first seven months of 2025, whereas in the first half of 2024, this figure was only 7.5 billion yuan. Behind the capital frenzy, however, data challenges remain difficult to conceal. From 2017 to the present year of 2025, she has almost witnessed the industry's rise from obscurity to global prominence and understands better than anyone that without solving data issues, even the highest financing amounts cannot sustain the industry's long-term growth. Wang Jianming frankly stated: "If the data problems of robots are not resolved, the embodied industry may not succeed with the current paradigm." The following is a conversation between AI Tech Review and Wang Jianming, edited by AI Tech Review without altering the original intent: 01 Just Wanting to Record AI Tech Review: Did you encounter any difficulties when you first started Shima Notes? How were they resolved? Wang Jianming: I didn’t encounter any difficulties.
excerpt_i18n.es: Cada noche a las 10, cuando la ciudad se sume en la tranquilidad, Wang Jianming, ED del fondo Inno Angel, inicia su "tiempo exclusivo de escritura"; los fines de semana también los dedica sistemáticamente a entrevistas y redacción. Esta perseverancia surge de su constante "Notas de Shima", que comenzó como un simple registro de información técnica en su trabajo, sin imaginar que atraería la atención de cada vez más profesionales del sector y transformaría gradualmente su visión de la industria robótica. Mucho antes de que la inteligencia corporeizada se convirtiera en un término de moda en el capital, Wang Jianming de Inno ya había entrado en el campo de la robótica. items.raw_excerpt: 国内知名视频博主“影视飓风”团队表示，已入驻全球最大的B2B出海平台阿里国际站，全面应用AI来开拓海外市场。据悉，目前影视飓风团队已收到30多国客户发来的合作意向。 据介绍，影视飓风团队使用了阿里国际站平台上的多个AI Agent，把商品信息一键翻译、生成适配海外市场的多语言产品介绍和视频，快速把海外店铺开起来。其店铺里的主营商品为T恤、连帽衫、运动服、配饰，与国内电商售卖的一致。 同时，影视飓风在接待海外客户时，也大量使用了平台的AI Agent辅助接待。 影视飓风创始人Tim在节目中表示，通过阿里国际站的AI，可以把国内电商的经验丝滑地复制到海外。这成为很多国内商家出海时可以借鉴的新路径。

excerpt_i18n.en:
The renowned Chinese video blogger team "Film Hurricane" announced that it has joined Alibaba International, the world's largest B2B cross-border platform, and is fully leveraging AI to expand into overseas markets. It is reported that the team has already received cooperation inquiries from clients in over 30 countries.  

According to the team, they utilized multiple AI agents on Alibaba International to translate product information with one click, generate multilingual product descriptions and videos tailored for overseas markets, and quickly set up their international store. Their main products include T-shirts, hoodies, sportswear, and accessories, which are consistent with those sold on their domestic e-commerce platform.  

Additionally, when engaging with overseas clients, the Film Hurricane team extensively employed the platform’s AI agents to assist with customer service.  

In a program, Tim, the founder of Film Hurricane, stated that through Alibaba International’s AI tools, domestic e-commerce experience can be seamlessly replicated overseas. This offers a new pathway for many domestic businesses looking to expand globally.
excerpt_i18n.es: El conocido equipo de videoblogueros chinos "Yingshi Jufeng" ha anunciado su incorporación a Alibaba.com, la mayor plataforma global de comercio electrónico B2B para la expansión internacional, utilizando ampliamente la inteligencia artificial para explorar mercados en el extranjero. Según se informa, el equipo ya ha recibido intenciones de colaboración de clientes en más de 30 países. Se destaca que han empleado múltiples agentes de IA disponibles en Alibaba.com para traducir automáticamente la información de productos, generar descripciones multilingües y videos adaptados a mercados internacionales, permitiendo la rápida apertura de su tienda en línea en el extranjero. Los productos principales en su tienda incluyen camisetas, sudaderas con capucha, ropa deportiva y accesorios, coincidiendo con los ofrecidos en su comercio electrónico nacional. Además, el equipo hace un uso extensivo de las herramientas de IA de la plataforma para atender a clientes internacionales.

title_i18n.es: El acuerdo entre Disney y OpenAI redefine la guerra de derechos de autor en la IA

excerpt_i18n.en: Disney is hedging against the future. OpenAI is clearing a path for Sora. And together they’ve made a blueprint for how AI and Hollywood can move forward.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 迪士尼正为未来布局，OpenAI为Sora铺路，二者共同绘制了人工智能与好莱坞协同发展的蓝图。
excerpt_i18n.es: Disney se está cubriendo ante el futuro. OpenAI está despejando el camino para Sora. Y juntos han creado un plan para cómo la IA y Hollywood pueden avanzar.

items.title: Disney invests $1 billion in OpenAI, licenses 200 characters for AI video app Sora
items.raw_excerpt: Three-year deal lets users create AI videos of Mickey Mouse, Darth Vader, and more.

title_i18n.en: Disney invests $1 billion in OpenAI, licenses 200 characters for AI video app Sora
title_i18n.zh: 迪士尼向OpenAI投资10亿美元，授权200个角色用于AI视频应用Sora。
title_i18n.es: Disney invierte mil millones de dólares en OpenAI y licencia 200 personajes para la aplicación de vídeo con IA Sora.

excerpt_i18n.en: Three-year deal lets users create AI videos of Mickey Mouse, Darth Vader, and more.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 三年协议允许用户制作米老鼠、达斯·维达等角色的AI视频。
excerpt_i18n.es: Acuerdo de tres años permite a los usuarios crear vídeos de IA de Mickey Mouse, Darth Vader y otros personajes.

title_i18n.en: Cursor Launches an AI Coding Tool For Designers
title_i18n.zh: Cursor推出面向设计师的AI编程工具
title_i18n.es: Cursor lanza una herramienta de programación con IA para diseñadores.

excerpt_i18n.en: The 300-person startup hopes bringing designers aboard will give it an edge in an increasingly competitive AI software market.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 这家300人的初创公司希望引入设计师能帮助其在竞争日益激烈的人工智能软件市场中占据优势。
excerpt_i18n.es: La startup de 300 personas espera que incorporar diseñadores le dé una ventaja en un mercado de software de IA cada vez más competitivo.
